title: Practice 1: Two verbs for every way of going

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Ты ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way)? Еда остывает.
exercises.why: They are used after the verb идти. *Где он был? — Он был здесь, там, дома.* — DLI, Lessons 19–20.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Are you coming? The food's getting cold.
exercises.context: They are used after the verb идти.

exercises.q: Как ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) поиски работы?

exercises.prompt: How is your job search going?
exercises.context: The corresponding question is куда: Куда они идут?

exercises.q: Куда ты в точности ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way)?
exercises.why: The goal of motion after the verb идти is usually indicated by the preposition в + Acc. — DLI, Lessons 19–20.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Where are you going exactly?
exercises.context: The goal of motion after the verb идти is usually indicated by the preposition в + Acc.

exercises.q: Перелётные птицы ___ (лететь — to fly, one way) к югу.
exercises.why: Лететь: this verb belongs to the 2nd (И) type of conjugation. — DLI, Lessons 19–20.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Migrating birds are flying south.
exercises.context: Лететь: this verb belongs to the 2nd (И) type of conjugation.

exercises.q: Ты какой авиакомпанией ___ (лететь — to fly, one way)?
exercises.why: Лететь: this verb belongs to the 2nd (И) type of conjugation. — DLI, Lessons 19–20.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Which airline are you flying with?
exercises.context: Лететь: this verb belongs to the 2nd (И) type of conjugation.

exercises.q: Дурная молва на крыльях ___ (лететь — to fly, one way).
exercises.why: The expression "to go by …" (means of transportation) is rendered in Russian by на + prepositional case: ехать на поезде (на автобусе, на автомобиле), лететь на самолёте. — DLI, Lessons 19–20.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Ill news comes apace.
exercises.context: The expression "to go by …" (means of transportation) is rendered in Russian by на + prepositional case: ехать на поезде (на автобусе, на автомобиле), лететь на самолёте.
